### Create `apps/api/test/integration/moderation-intake.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { laneFor, snapshotDigest, type SnapshotDigestInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { recordIntake } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { aPost, anAccount, gate, ground, intake, moderationDeps, newPostRow, refusal, removeFixtures, rowCounts, untilBlocked, uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack, withLockTimeout } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Most tests here run dozens of statements inside one open transaction, each a round trip: on a loaded machine that
// takes longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * The intake's transaction and what the social module hands the moderation module (3c design, sections 5 and 7.1, step
 * 4), against the real database: the moderation module's recordIntake as the routes of a later task will call it, as
 * korbat_api. A test with one session runs inside a transaction that is rolled back (the module's own transaction is
 * then a savepoint of it); the one test with two sessions commits, and removes what it committed in a `finally`. The
 * runs the module makes again after a deadlock, a lock timeout or a closed case are tested without a database
 * (test/moderation-retry.test.ts) and, for a case a decision closed under an intake, with one (moderation-races.test.ts).
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: taking in a report, a notice or a finding", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const profile = (db: Db | DbTx) => newProfile(db as Db);
  /** The snapshots of these cases as stored, each with the digest recomputed from its own columns. */
  async function snapshots(tx: DbTx, caseIds: readonly string[]) {
    const iso = (column: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${column} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);
    const rows = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown> & { case_id: string; digest: string }>(sql`
      select s.case_id, s.target_type, s.target_id, ${iso("s.taken_at")} as taken, s.author_handle, s.post_state, ${iso("s.post_created_at")} as created, s.reply_to_id, s.quote_of_id, s.body, s.media,
             s.display_name, s.bio, s.handle, s.salt, s.digest
        from evidence_snapshots s where s.case_id = any(${uuids(caseIds)}) order by s.taken_at, s.id`);
    return Promise.all(
      rows.map(async (row) => {
        const input = {
          salt: row.salt,
          targetType: row.target_type,
          targetId: row.target_id,
          takenAt: row.taken,
          authorHandle: row.author_handle,
          postState: row.post_state,
          postCreatedAt: row.created,
          replyToId: row.reply_to_id,
          quoteOfId: row.quote_of_id,
          body: row.body,
          media: row.media,
          displayName: row.display_name,
          bio: row.bio,
          handle: row.handle,
        } as SnapshotDigestInput;
        return { caseId: row.case_id, ...input, digest: row.digest, recomputed: await snapshotDigest(input) };
      }),
    );
  }

  describe("recordIntake", () => {
    test("one intake stores its row, one item for each target in that target's open case, and the first copy of each target under a digest that recomputes", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const [ada, bob, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const [adas, bobs] = [await newPostRow(tx, ada.id, { body: "what ada wrote" }), await newPostRow(tx, bob.id, { body: "what bob wrote" })];
        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R4"), [aPost(bobs, 1), anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle.toUpperCase(), 2), aPost(adas, 3)]);
        expect(recorded).toMatchObject({ token: null, suspect: false });
        expect(recorded.ref).toMatch(/^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$/);
        expect(recorded.items.map((item) => [item.position, item.targetType, item.targetId, item.seq, item.lane])).toEqual([
          [1, "post", bobs, 1, 1],
          [2, "account", ada.id, 1, 1],
          [3, "post", adas, 1, 1],
        ]);
        const caseIds = recorded.items.map((item) => item.caseId!);
        expect(new Set(caseIds).size).toBe(3);

        const [stored] = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select kind, channel, reporter_id, rule_id, alleges_illegal, csam, lookup_hash, ref from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...stored! }).toEqual({ kind: "user", channel: "signed_in", reporter_id: reporter.id, rule_id: "R4", alleges_illegal: false, csam: false, lookup_hash: null, ref: recorded.ref });
        const items = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
          select i.position, i.named_handle, i.reporter_account_id, i.suspect, i.outcome, c.target_id, c.intake_seq, c.closed_at, c.lane
            from intake_items i join cases c on c.id = i.case_id where i.intake_id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid order by i.position`);
        expect(items.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { position: 1, named_handle: null, reporter_account_id: reporter.id, suspect: false, outcome: null, target_id: bobs, intake_seq: 1, closed_at: null, lane: 1 },
          // The handle is kept as it was named, in lower case.
          { position: 2, named_handle: ada.handle, reporter_account_id: reporter.id, suspect: false, outcome: null, target_id: ada.id, intake_seq: 1, closed_at: null, lane: 1 },
          { position: 3, named_handle: null, reporter_account_id: reporter.id, suspect: false, outcome: null, target_id: adas, intake_seq: 1, closed_at: null, lane: 1 },
        ]);

        const copies = await snapshots(tx, caseIds);
        expect(copies).toHaveLength(3);
        for (const copy of copies) expect(copy.recomputed, copy.targetId).toBe(copy.digest);
        const of = (caseId: string) => copies.find((copy) => copy.caseId === caseId)!;
        expect(of(caseIds[0]!)).toMatchObject({ targetType: "post", targetId: bobs, authorHandle: bob.handle, postState: "visible", body: "what bob wrote", media: [], displayName: null, bio: null, handle: null });
        expect(of(caseIds[1]!)).toMatchObject({ targetType: "account", targetId: ada.id, authorHandle: ada.handle, postState: null, postCreatedAt: null, body: null, media: null, displayName: `Profile ${ada.handle}`, bio: "", handle: ada.handle });
        expect(of(caseIds[2]!)).toMatchObject({ targetType: "post", targetId: adas, authorHandle: ada.handle, body: "what ada wrote" });
      });
    });

    test("a later intake joins the target's open case; a post is copied once, an account again only when its fields changed; the same sender on the same ground is already_reported", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const [ada, first, second] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, ada.id);
        const targets = [aPost(postId, 1), anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle, 2)];
        const one = await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id), targets);
        const two = await intake(tx, ground.rule(second.id), targets);
        expect(two.items.map((item) => [item.caseId, item.seq])).toEqual(one.items.map((item) => [item.caseId, 2]));
        const caseIds = one.items.map((item) => item.caseId!);
        expect(await snapshots(tx, caseIds)).toHaveLength(2);

        // The account changed its bio: the next report about it copies it again; the post's copy stays the one.
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set bio = 'a new bio' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id), targets);
        const copies = await snapshots(tx, caseIds);
        expect(copies.map((copy) => [copy.targetType, copy.bio])).toEqual([["post", null], ["account", ""], ["account", "a new bio"]]);
        for (const copy of copies) expect(copy.recomputed).toBe(copy.digest);

        // One item for each sender, case and ground: the refusal stores nothing, also not for the other target.
        expect(await refusal(intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id), targets))).toBe("already_reported");
        expect(await refusal(intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id), [aPost(await newPostRow(tx, ada.id), 1), anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle, 2)]))).toBe("already_reported");
        const [count] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from intakes where reporter_id = ${first.id}::uuid`);
        expect(count!.n).toBe(1);
        // On another ground the same sender is heard again.
        expect(await refusal(intake(tx, ground.illegal(first.id), targets))).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("a notice sent signed out, or on the path for child sexual abuse material, gets a token that is stored only as its hash", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, (await profile(tx)).id);
        for (const sent of [ground.illegal(null), ground.csam()]) {
          const recorded = await intake(tx, sent, aPost(postId));
          expect(recorded.token).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
          expect(recorded.suspect).toBe(sent.csam);
          expect(recorded.items[0]!.lane).toBe(laneFor(sent));
          const [stored] = await tx.execute<{ lookup_hash: string; reporter_id: string | null; channel: string }>(sql`select lookup_hash, reporter_id, channel from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
          expect({ ...stored! }).toEqual({ lookup_hash: createHash("sha256").update(recorded.token!).digest("hex"), reporter_id: null, channel: "signed_out" });
        }
        // Signed-out notices are never merged: each is an item of its own in the case.
        const [items] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where target_id = ${postId}::uuid`);
        expect(items!.n).toBe(2);
      });
    });

    test("a suspect report about a post that quotes another adds an item for the quoted post, once, at the lowest position that quotes it plus 10, and one level deep", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const post = (options: { quoteOfId?: string } = {}) => newPostRow(tx, author.id, options);
        const deepest = await post();
        const quoted = await post({ quoteOfId: deepest });
        const [alone, quotingOne, quotingTwo] = [await post(), await post({ quoteOfId: quoted }), await post({ quoteOfId: quoted })];
        // A post that the notice names itself and that another named post quotes gets no second item.
        const named = await post();
        const quotingNamed = await post({ quoteOfId: named });
        const targets = [aPost(alone, 1), aPost(quotingTwo, 5), aPost(quotingOne, 2), aPost(named, 3), aPost(quotingNamed, 4)];

        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.csam(), targets);
        expect(recorded.suspect).toBe(true);
        expect(recorded.items.map((item) => [item.position, item.targetId])).toEqual([[1, alone], [2, quotingOne], [3, named], [4, quotingNamed], [5, quotingTwo], [12, quoted]]);
        // The rule the database holds at commit passes, and nothing was added for the post the quoted post quotes.
        expect(await pgError(tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.intake_items_quote immediate`))).toBeNull();
        await tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.intake_items_quote deferred`);
        const [deep] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where target_id = ${deepest}::uuid`);
        expect(deep!.n).toBe(0);
        // Every case holds its copy, the added item's too.
        expect(await snapshots(tx, recorded.items.map((item) => item.caseId!))).toHaveLength(6);

        // A finding citing R2 is suspect too; a report under any other rule adds nothing.
        const finder = await profile(tx);
        expect((await intake(tx, ground.finding(finder.id, "R2"), aPost(quotingOne))).items.map((item) => item.position)).toEqual([1, 11]);
        expect((await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id, "R5"), aPost(quotingOne))).items.map((item) => item.position)).toEqual([1]);
      });
    });

    test("a target with nothing live is stored without a case, answered at once as not available; an account's link that names nothing gets an id that names nothing", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const live = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
        const gone = randomUUID();
        const recorded = await recordIntake(moderationDeps(tx), {
          ground: ground.rule(reporter.id),
          live: [aPost(live, 2)],
          dead: [{ type: "post", id: gone, position: 1 }, { type: "account", position: 3, namedHandle: "Nobody_Here" }],
        });
        expect(recorded.items.map((item) => [item.position, item.targetType, item.caseId === null, item.seq])).toEqual([[1, "post", true, null], [2, "post", false, 1], [3, "account", true, null]]);
        const rows = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select position, target_id, named_handle, outcome, case_id is null as no_case from intake_items where intake_id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid order by position`);
        expect(rows.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { position: 1, target_id: gone, named_handle: null, outcome: "not_available", no_case: true },
          { position: 2, target_id: live, named_handle: null, outcome: null, no_case: false },
          { position: 3, target_id: recorded.items[2]!.targetId, named_handle: "nobody_here", outcome: "not_available", no_case: true },
        ]);
        const [profiles] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from profiles where id = ${recorded.items[2]!.targetId}::uuid`);
        expect(profiles!.n).toBe(0);
      });
    });

    test("a sender whose account is deleted or does not exist is refused, and nothing is stored", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, (await profile(tx)).id);
        const deleted = await profile(tx);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted.id}::uuid`);
        const counts = await rowCounts(tx);
        expect(await refusal(intake(tx, ground.rule(deleted.id), aPost(postId)))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await refusal(intake(tx, ground.rule(randomUUID()), aPost(postId)))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await rowCounts(tx)).toEqual(counts);
      });
    });

    test("what is copied of a post its author deleted and of one whose content was erased: no text", async () => {
      // As the migrator: only its erasure, which a later migration brings, writes the erasure time.
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const [deleted, erased] = [await newPostRow(tx, author.id, { body: "deleted text" }), await newPostRow(tx, author.id, { body: "erased text" })];
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted}::uuid`);
        // The body is left in place here, to show that the copy leaves it out by the erasure time alone.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set erased_at = now() where id = ${erased}::uuid`);
        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.csam(), [aPost(deleted, 1), aPost(erased, 2)]);
        const copies = await snapshots(tx, recorded.items.map((item) => item.caseId!));
        expect(copies.map((copy) => [copy.targetId, copy.postState, copy.body]).sort()).toEqual([[deleted, "deleted_by_author", ""], [erased, "visible", ""]].sort());
        for (const copy of copies) expect(copy.recomputed).toBe(copy.digest);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("what the social module hands over", () => {
    test("findAccountByHandle: a live holder by its handle in any case; with withDeleted also a deleted profile and the account of a handle it has left", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const social = socialForModeration(tx as unknown as Db);
        const [live, deleted, moved] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted.id}::uuid`);
        const left = `old_${moved.handle}`;
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into handle_history (handle_lower, profile_id, changed_at) values (${left}, ${moved.id}::uuid, now())`);

        for (const withDeleted of [false, true]) expect(await social.findAccountByHandle(live.handle.toUpperCase(), withDeleted)).toEqual({ id: live.id, deleted: false });
        expect(await social.findAccountByHandle(deleted.handle, false)).toBeNull();
        expect(await social.findAccountByHandle(deleted.handle, true)).toEqual({ id: deleted.id, deleted: true });
        expect(await social.findAccountByHandle(left, false)).toBeNull();
        expect(await social.findAccountByHandle(left.toUpperCase(), true)).toEqual({ id: moved.id, deleted: false });
        for (const withDeleted of [false, true]) expect(await social.findAccountByHandle("nobody_holds_this", withDeleted)).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("lockAccounts answers each row with whether it is deleted, and with `live` refuses a missing or deleted one; postAuthor and postRef read a post", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const social = socialForModeration(tx as unknown as Db);
        const [live, deleted] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted.id}::uuid`);
        const byId = (rows: { id: string; deleted: boolean }[]) => [...rows].sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
        expect(byId(await social.lockAccounts(tx, [live.id, deleted.id, live.id, randomUUID()], "no key update"))).toEqual(byId([{ id: live.id, deleted: false }, { id: deleted.id, deleted: true }]));
        expect(await social.lockAccounts(tx, [], "key share", true)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await social.lockAccounts(tx, [live.id], "key share", true)).toEqual([{ id: live.id, deleted: false }]);
        expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => social.lockAccounts(sp, [live.id, deleted.id], "key share", true)))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => social.lockAccounts(sp, [randomUUID()], "key share", true)))).toBe("not_found");

        const quoted = await newPostRow(tx, deleted.id);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, live.id, { quoteOfId: quoted });
        expect(await social.postAuthor(postId)).toBe(live.id);
        expect(await social.postAuthor(randomUUID())).toBeNull();
        expect(await social.postRef(postId)).toEqual({ authorId: live.id, state: "visible", quoteOfId: quoted });
        expect(await social.postRef(randomUUID())).toBeNull();
        expect(await social.capturePost(tx, randomUUID())).toBeNull();
        expect(await social.captureProfile(tx, randomUUID())).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("deletePost takes its author's profile row before the post: it waits for a transaction that holds that row, and holds no post meanwhile", async () => {
      const author = await profile(apiDb);
      try {
        const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
        const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
        // A decision about the author holds the profile row in this mode before it takes any post.
        const holder = withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${author.id}::uuid for no key update`);
          held.open();
          await release.opened;
        });
        await held.opened;
        const deleting = createSocialRepo(apiDb).deletePost(postId, author.id, new Date());
        try {
          // The holder is idle; the session that waits for a lock on this statement is the deletion's.
          await untilBlocked(apiDb, "from profiles where id");
          // The deletion has not touched the post: its row can be locked without waiting.
          expect(await pgError(withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`select id from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid for update nowait`)))).toBeNull();
          const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
          expect(row!.state).toBe("visible");
        } finally {
          release.open();
          await holder;
        }
        expect(await deleting).toBe(true);
        const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...row! }).toEqual({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" });
      } finally {
        await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [author.id]);
      }
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/moderation-races.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { auditVerify } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { recordIntake } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, insertAction, insertDecision } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import {
  aPost,
  act,
  decisionParams,
  gate,
  ground,
  hex64,
  imageStates,
  madeUpConfirmation,
  newImageRow,
  newPostRow,
  postRow,
  raised,
  refusal,
  removeFixtures,
  rowCounts,
  untilBlocked,
  type DecisionInput,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack, withLockTimeout } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test makes real, confirmed decisions (a step-up for each) and several hold one transaction open until another
// session waits for it: on a loaded machine that takes far longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * Decisions that commit, and what races them (3c design, sections 6.2 and 7.5), against the real database. A committed
 * decision's audit row stays for good and audit-verify checks every one, so each decision here is confirmed as the
 * console confirms it: by a staff key on the software authenticator, in a staff session (moderation-decide.ts). The races
 * are made to happen, never waited for: a transaction of the migrator holds the audit chain's head, which stops a decision
 * at its last statement while it holds every lock it took, the other session is started, and the test goes on only once
 * the database reports that session as waiting for a lock. Every test removes what it committed in a `finally`; the audit
 * rows stay, as the record does. The file's last test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: committed decisions and what races them", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  /** An admin whose key and role these tests take away. */
  let leaving: RealStaff;
  /** A moderator whose key is revoked before a decision of theirs is stored. */
  let revoked: RealStaff;
  /** A moderator with no decision yet, for the cap. */
  let capped: RealStaff;
  /** A moderator whose account is demoted to user and then taken down. */
  let takenDown: RealStaff;
  /** A moderator whose key the real revocation revokes. */
  let ordered: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 8 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    ({ migrateDb, authDb } = world);
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    leaving = await world.staff("admin");
    revoked = await world.staff("moderator");
    capped = await world.staff("moderator");
    takenDown = await world.staff("moderator");
    ordered = await world.staff("moderator");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await world.close();
    await closeDb(apiDb);
  });

  /** A committed post with this many images, reported under a rule or on the path for child sexual abuse material, and its open case. Everything is removed after `fn`. */
  async function withReported(fn: (made: { authorId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[]; caseId: string }) => Promise<void>, options: { images?: number; by?: "rule" | "csam" } = {}) {
    const [author, reporter] = [await newProfile(apiDb), await newProfile(apiDb)];
    try {
      const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
      const mediaIds: string[] = [];
      for (let position = 0; position < (options.images ?? 0); position++) mediaIds.push(await newImageRow(apiDb, author.id, postId, position));
      const recorded = await recordIntake(world.moderation.deps, { ground: options.by === "csam" ? ground.csam() : ground.rule(reporter.id), live: [aPost(postId)] });
      await fn({ authorId: author.id, postId, mediaIds, caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId! });
    } finally {
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [author.id, reporter.id]);
    }
  }
  /** A verified confirmation of a decision on the case, and the call that records it: built before anything is held, since a step-up reads and writes rows of its own. */
  async function prepared(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput) {
    const confirmed = await world.confirm(member, caseId, await decisionParams(apiDb, member, caseId, input));
    return () => world.moderation.forStaff.decide(member.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }
  /** Runs `fn` while a transaction of the migrator holds what this statement locks. `letGo` ends the hold; it ends in any case when `fn` does. */
  async function whileHeld<T>(lock: ReturnType<typeof sql>, fn: (letGo: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
    const holder = withLockTimeout(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(lock);
      held.open();
      await release.opened;
    });
    await held.opened;
    const letGo = async () => {
      release.open();
      await holder;
    };
    try {
      return await fn(letGo);
    } finally {
      await letGo();
    }
  }
  /** While the audit chain's head is held, a decision stops at its audit row, its last statement, holding every lock it took. */
  const whileHeadHeld = <T>(fn: (letGo: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<T>) => whileHeld(sql`select 1 from public.audit_head where id = 1 for update`, fn);
  /**
   * While the lock under which one person's decisions are counted is held, a decision of theirs stops inside
   * decisions_record: it has locked its case and read its texts, and has written nothing yet.
   */
  const whileCapHeld = <T>(member: RealStaff, fn: (letGo: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<T>) =>
    whileHeld(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('korbat.decision_cap:' || ${member.id}::text, 0))`, fn);
  const decisionsOf = async (caseId: string) => (await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`))[0]!.n;
  /** The moderation module's dependencies over the same pool, counting how often an intake's transaction is run. */
  function counting() {
    let runs = 0;
    const transaction = ((...args: Parameters<Db["transaction"]>) => {
      runs++;
      return apiDb.transaction(...args);
    }) as Db["transaction"];
    return { deps: { ...world.moderation.deps, apiDb: Object.assign(Object.create(apiDb) as Db, { transaction }) }, runs: () => runs };
  }
  /**
   * A direct call of the audit function as korbat_api, for this account and key, with a made-up assertion: only ever
   * inside a transaction that is rolled back, since audit-verify would refuse the row for good.
   */
  const auditCall = (tx: DbTx, member: { id: string; keyId: string }, options: { expires?: number; requestId?: string } = {}) =>
    tx.execute(sql`select public.append_confirmed_audit(${member.id}::uuid, ${member.keyId}::uuid, 'case_decided'::text, 'case', ${randomUUID()}::text, '{"params": {}}'::jsonb, ${randomUUID()}::uuid,
      ${hex64()}::text, '{"signature": "x"}'::jsonb, ${options.requestId ?? "req-direct"}::text, ${options.expires ?? Date.now() + 60_000}::bigint)`);
  /** What that call was refused with, in a transaction of its own (lock waits bounded at 10 seconds) that is rolled back whatever it answered; null when it wrote its row. */
  const auditCallRefusal = (member: { id: string; keyId: string }, options: { expires?: number; requestId?: string } = {}) =>
    pgError(rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => void (await auditCall(tx, member, options))));

  test("a confirmed decision commits with its measures and its audit row, and audit-verify accepts the record", async () => {
    await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
      const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
      expect(outcome).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/) });
      const decisionId = (outcome as { decisionId: string }).decisionId;
      expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", level: "withheld" });
      const [audit] = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
        select l.actor_id, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.key_id, l.staff_session, l.step_up is not null as confirmed, l.metadata ->> 'decisionId' as decision,
               l.chain_seq = (select max(chain_seq) from audit_log) as newest
          from audit_log l where l.metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${decisionId}`);
      expect({ ...audit! }).toEqual({ actor_id: admin.id, action: "case_decided", target_type: "case", target_id: caseId, key_id: admin.keyId, staff_session: admin.session.handle, confirmed: true, decision: decisionId, newest: true });
      // The whole record, this row included, as the command line checks it.
      const connections = { api: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 }), auth: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 }) };
      try {
        expect(await auditVerify(connections, [])).toMatchObject({ ok: true, problems: [], problemCount: 0 });
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
      // A measure cannot be added to it afterwards: a ledger row comes only with its own decision, in that decision's transaction.
      const late = await pgError(withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`insert into decision_actions (decision_id, kind) values (${decisionId}::uuid, 'restore')`)));
      expect(late).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "invalid_decision" });
    });
  });

  test("an item that waited for a decision which then closed its case is not stored there: the intake runs again and opens a new case", async () => {

        const counted = counting();
        const [decided, reported] = await whileCapHeld(admin, async (letGo) => {
          const deciding = decide();

          await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decisions");
          const reporting = recordIntake(counted.deps, { ground: ground.rule(sender.id), live: [aPost(postId)] });
          // The report read the open case, and its item now waits for that case's row.

  test("a revocation of the key, a demotion and a take-down of the account all wait for a decision that is being recorded, which commits; the next decision is refused", async () => {
    await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {

      const decided = await whileHeadHeld(async (letGo) => {
        const deciding = decide();
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
        // Both rows are held by the decision until it commits: none of the three statements can slip in before it.
        const revoking = withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_keys set revoked_at = now() where id = ${leaving.keyId}::uuid`));
        await untilBlocked(authDb, "update auth.staff_keys");
        const demoting = withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = ${leaving.id}::uuid`));
        await untilBlocked(authDb, "set role = 'moderator'");
        const takingDown = withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${leaving.id}::uuid`));
        await untilBlocked(authDb, "set deleted_at = now()");
        await letGo();
        const outcome = await deciding;
        await Promise.all([revoking, demoting, takingDown]);
        return outcome;
      });
      expect(decided).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
      expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "removed", level: "removed" });
      // The decision's audit row names the key, which was live when the row was written; both statements then went through.
      const [audit] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log where action = 'case_decided' and target_id = ${caseId} and key_id = ${leaving.keyId}::uuid`);

      const [now] = await authDb.execute<{ revoked: boolean; role: string; deleted: boolean }>(
        sql`select k.revoked_at is not null as revoked, u.role::text as role, u.deleted_at is not null as deleted from auth.staff_keys k join auth.users u on u.id = k.user_id where k.id = ${leaving.keyId}::uuid`,
      );
      expect({ ...now! }).toEqual({ revoked: true, role: "moderator", deleted: true });
      // Demoted, taken down and without a live key: a correction of that decision, confirmed with what the session still
      // holds, is refused by the role before the account and the key are looked at, and stores nothing.
      const { session, confirmed } = madeUpConfirmation(leaving, caseId, await decisionParams(apiDb, leaving, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: (decided as { decisionId: string }).decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] }));
      expect(await refusal(world.moderation.forStaff.decide(session, confirmed, { requestId: "req-refused" }))).toBe("admin_required");
      expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  test("the audit function itself: it refuses a challenge past its expiry, an account or a key that is not live staff's own, and any action but the three of moderation cases", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const call = (changed: { actor?: string; key?: string; action?: string; expires?: number; stepUp?: string | null } = {}) =>
        pgError(
          tx.transaction((sp: DbTx) =>
            sp.execute(sql`select public.append_confirmed_audit(${changed.actor ?? admin.id}::uuid, ${changed.key ?? admin.keyId}::uuid, ${changed.action ?? "case_decided"}::text, 'case', ${randomUUID()}::text,
              '{"params": {}}'::jsonb, ${admin.session.handle}::uuid, ${hex64()}::text, ${changed.stepUp === undefined ? '{"signature": "x"}' : changed.stepUp}::jsonb, 'req-direct', ${changed.expires ?? Date.now() + 60_000}::bigint)`),
          ),
        );
      const ended = { code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_ended" };
      expect(await call({ expires: Date.now() - 1 })).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_late" });
      // The revoked moderator's key, another account's live key, an account that is not staff, and one that does not exist.
      expect(await call({ actor: revoked.id, key: revoked.keyId })).toEqual(ended);
      expect(await call({ key: capped.keyId })).toEqual(ended);
      expect(await call({ actor: (await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id })).toEqual(ended);
      expect(await call({ actor: randomUUID(), key: randomUUID() })).toEqual(ended);
      expect((await call({ action: "staff_session_revoked" }))?.message).toMatch(/does not write the action/);
      expect((await call({ stepUp: null }))?.message).toMatch(/needs an actor, a key, a staff session, an action hash, a step-up and an expiry/);
      // With everything in order it writes the row; this one is rolled back, since no key signed it.
      expect(await call()).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("two decisions of one person at the cap's last place: exactly one commits", async () => {
    await withReported(async (one) => {
      await withReported(async (two) => {
        const input: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] };
        const [first, second] = [await prepared(capped, one.caseId, input), await prepared(capped, two.caseId, input)];
        // The limits' row is the suite's to keep: lowered here to one decision an hour, and put back whatever happens.
        await migrateDb.execute(sql`update moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = 1 where id = 1`);
        try {
          const settled = <T>(promise: Promise<T>) => promise.then((value) => value as unknown, (err: unknown) => err);
          const outcomes = await whileHeadHeld(async (letGo) => {
            // The first decision is counted and written, and waits for the chain's head with the counting lock held.
            const earlier = settled(first());
            await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
            // The second waits for that lock, inside the insert of its own row.
            const later = settled(second());
            await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decisions");
            await letGo();
            return Promise.all([earlier, later]);
          });
          expect(outcomes[0]).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
          expect(outcomes[1]).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
          expect(outcomes[1]).toMatchObject({ code: "decision_cap" });
          expect([await decisionsOf(one.caseId), await decisionsOf(two.caseId)]).toEqual([1, 0]);
          expect([(await postRow(apiDb, one.postId)).state, (await postRow(apiDb, two.postId)).state]).toEqual(["withheld", "visible"]);
        } finally {
          await migrateDb.execute(sql`update moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = 60 where id = 1`);
        }
      });
    });
  });

  describe("the check at COMMIT covers every row of the ledger", () => {
    /**
     * A decision's statements as the API issues them, in one transaction of korbat_api that commits: the subject's lock,
     * the decision's row, its ledger rows and, last, the audit row, confirmed by a real key. `after` runs once the audit row
     * is written. Answers what the transaction was refused with, or null when it committed.
     */
    async function committing(made: { authorId: string; caseId: string }, input: DecisionInput, after: (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string) => Promise<void>) {
      const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, admin, made.caseId, input);
      const confirmed = await world.confirm(admin, made.caseId, params);
      const decisionId = randomUUID();
      const refused = await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select id from profiles where id = ${made.authorId}::uuid for no key update`);
        await insertDecision(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: made.caseId, decidedBy: admin.id, params });
        for (const action of params.actions) await insertAction(tx, decisionId, action);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: admin.id,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "case_decided",
          targetType: "case",
          targetId: made.caseId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, decisionId },
          staffSession: admin.session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        await after(tx, decisionId);
      }).then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => raised(err),
      );
      return { decisionId, refused };
    }
    const unlisted = { code: "P0001", message: "invalid_decision", detail: "actions: the decision's measures and reversals are not those the audit row's params list." };

    test("a measure added after the check was made to run early is refused: at once while the checks are immediate, and at COMMIT once they are deferred again", async () => {
      await withReported(
        async (made) => {
          const input: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] };
          const further = act("withhold_media", made.mediaIds[0]!);
          let inserted = false;
          // The checks run early and pass. While they stay immediate, the further row's own check runs with its insert.
          const atOnce = await committing(made, input, async (tx, decisionId) => {
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
            await insertAction(tx, decisionId, further);
            inserted = true;
          });
          expect(inserted).toBe(false);
          expect(atOnce.refused).toEqual(unlisted);
          // Deferred again, the insert itself passes, and the check it queued refuses the COMMIT.
          const atCommit = await committing(made, input, async (tx, decisionId) => {
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all deferred`);
            await insertAction(tx, decisionId, further);
            inserted = true;
          });
          expect(inserted).toBe(true);
          expect(atCommit.refused).toEqual(unlisted);
          expect(await decisionsOf(made.caseId)).toBe(0);
          expect(await postRow(apiDb, made.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
          expect(await imageStates(apiDb, made.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
        },
        { images: 1 },
      );
    });

    test("the same further measure, inserted before the audit row and listed in its params, commits", async () => {
      await withReported(
        async (made) => {
          const { decisionId, refused } = await committing(made, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold"), act("withhold_media", made.mediaIds[0]!)] }, async (tx) => {
            // Made to run early here too: every row is in the params, so the check passes now as it would at COMMIT.
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
          });
          expect(refused).toBeNull();
          const actions = await apiDb.execute<{ kind: string }>(sql`select kind from decision_actions where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by kind::text`);
          expect(actions.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(["withhold", "withhold_media"]);
          expect(await postRow(apiDb, made.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", level: "withheld" });
          expect(await imageStates(apiDb, made.mediaIds)).toEqual(["withheld"]);
        },
        { images: 1 },
      );
    });
  });

  describe("append_confirmed_audit: the account, the key and the clock", () => {
    const ended = { code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_ended" };

    test("an account demoted to user, and one taken down, is refused while its key is live; a take-down waits for a call that holds the account's row", async () => {
      await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
        const decide = await prepared(takenDown, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toBeNull();
        // Demoted to user: the function's account statement refuses, whatever the key.
        await authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'user' where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toEqual(ended);
        await authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toBeNull();

        // The function takes the account's row itself (no decision's trigger ran here): a take-down that comes while the
        // call's transaction is open waits for it.
        const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
        const calling = rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
          await auditCall(tx, takenDown);
          held.open();
          await release.opened;
        });
        await held.opened;
        const takingDown = withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`));
        try {
          await untilBlocked(authDb, "update auth.users");
        } finally {
          release.open();
          await calling;
        }
        await takingDown;

        // Taken down first: a direct call is ended, and so is a decision the key confirmed before, which stores nothing.
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toEqual(ended);
        expect(await decide()).toBe("ended");
        expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(0);
        expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
      });
    });

    test("the call takes the account's row before the key's, as the real revocation does, so the two cannot deadlock in either order", async () => {
      const probe = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
      /** Runs a direct call while a transaction of the auth role holds what `lock` takes; `during` runs once the call waits. */
      async function callBehind(lock: ReturnType<typeof sql>, during: () => Promise<void>) {
        const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
        const holder = withLockTimeout(authDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(lock);
          held.open();
          await release.opened;
        });
        await held.opened;
        const calling = auditCallRefusal(ordered);
        try {
          await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
          await during();
        } finally {
          release.open();
          await holder;
        }
        expect(await calling).toBeNull();
      }
      // The key's row held: the call waits for it, and already holds the account's row.
      await callBehind(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for update`, async () => {
        expect((await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${ordered.id}::uuid for update nowait`))?.code).toBe("55P03");
      });
      // The account's row held: the call waits for it, and has not touched the key's row.
      await callBehind(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${ordered.id}::uuid for update`, async () => {
        expect(await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for update nowait`)).toBeNull();
      });

      // The real revocation, started while a call holds both rows, waits at its first lock, the account's row: it has not
      // touched the key, which still carries only the call's shared lock.
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      const calling = rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await auditCall(tx, ordered);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const revoking = createAuthRepo(authDb).revokeStaffKeys({ account: { id: ordered.id }, key: "all", suspect: false, via: "cli", actorId: ordered.id, now: new Date() });
      try {
        await untilBlocked(authDb, "for no key update");
        expect(await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for share nowait`)).toBeNull();
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await calling;
      }
      expect(await revoking).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      // Revoked first: the call is ended at the key.
      expect(await auditCallRefusal(ordered)).toEqual(ended);
    });

    test("a call whose row joins the chain after the challenge's expiry, because it waited for the head, is refused as late and stores nothing", async () => {
      const requestId = `req-late-${randomUUID()}`;
      const expires = Date.now() + 1500;
      const refused = await whileHeadHeld(async (letGo) => {
        const calling = auditCallRefusal(admin, { expires, requestId });
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
        // Held past the expiry: the row is stamped only once its transaction has the head.
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, expires - Date.now()) + 500));
        await letGo();
        return calling;
      });
      expect(refused).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_late" });
      const [stored] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log where request_id = ${requestId}`);
      expect(stored!.n).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

 * transaction every time is that transaction's start: so the tests of the release run as the migrator, which dates a
 * decision, a reversal or a pending mark back, inside a transaction that is rolled back. Every cut-off they pass lies at
 * least an hour back, so a release never touches what another suite's decisions left in the shared database minutes ago.
 * The file's last test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the release of outcomes, withheld snapshots and a case's history", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** One test's world: a transaction of the given pool that is rolled back, with the moderator's profile in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>, db: Db = migrateDb) =>
    rolledBack(db, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const profile = (tx: DbTx) => newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
  /** The release with a cut-off this long ago; answers how many items it changed. */
  const release = async (tx: DbTx, ago: string) => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now() - ${ago}::interval) as n`))[0]!.n;
  /** Dates a decision, with its measures and reversals, back. */
  const decidedAgo = async (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string, ago: string) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
    await tx.execute(sql`update decision_actions set created_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
  };
  /** What an item's sender is shown and owed. */
  const shown = async (tx: DbTx, itemId: string) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ outcome: string | null; shown: string | null; released: boolean; pending: boolean; revised: boolean; mail: string }>(sql`
      select outcome, shown_outcome as shown, outcome_sent_at is not null as released, revision_pending_at is not null as pending, revised_sent_at is not null as revised, outcome_mail as mail
        from intake_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
    return { ...row! };
  };
  /** A post with a notice of illegality by a signed-in reporter, who is owed a mail about its outcome. */
  async function noticed(tx: DbTx, images = 0) {
    const p = await imagePost(tx, images);
    const { caseId, recorded } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
    return { ...p, caseId, itemId: recorded.items[0]!.id };

  describe("release_outcomes", () => {
    test("it releases what was answered before the cut-off, with its outcome as of the cut-off, and leaves the rest for the next one", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        // Whatever other suites' decisions left releasable in the shared database goes first, so the counts below are this test's own.
        await release(tx, "1 hour");

        const cleared = await noticed(tx);
        await decidedAgo(tx, await decideIn(tx, mod, cleared.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }), "5 hours");
        // Answered just now: after every cut-off these releases pass.
        const fresh = await noticed(tx);
        await decideIn(tx, mod, fresh.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        // A link that named nothing live, answered at intake three hours ago: its own time counts.
        const dead = await insertItem(tx, { intakeId: await ruleReport(tx, (await profile(tx)).id), caseId: null, targetId: randomUUID(), outcome: "not_available" });
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set created_at = now() - interval '3 hours' where id = ${dead.id}::uuid`);
        // Removed five hours ago and restored four hours ago: its sender is told the outcome as it stands at the cut-off.
        const undone = await noticed(tx);
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, undone.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await decidedAgo(tx, removal, "5 hours");
        await decidedAgo(tx, await decideIn(tx, mod, undone.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore")] }), "4 hours");
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set revision_pending_at = now() - interval '4 hours' where id = ${undone.itemId}::uuid`);
        // Removed five hours ago and restored just now: released as it stood, the reversal waits for the next release.
        const late = await noticed(tx);

        expect(await shown(tx, cleared.itemId)).toEqual({ outcome: "no_violation", shown: null, released: false, pending: false, revised: false, mail: "pending" });
        expect(await release(tx, "1 hour")).toBe(4);
        expect(await shown(tx, cleared.itemId)).toEqual({ outcome: "no_violation", shown: "no_violation", released: true, pending: false, revised: false, mail: "pending" });
        expect(await shown(tx, dead.id)).toMatchObject({ outcome: "not_available", shown: "not_available", released: true });
        expect(await shown(tx, undone.itemId)).toEqual({ outcome: "restricted_rule", shown: "reversed", released: true, pending: false, revised: false, mail: "pending" });
        expect(await shown(tx, late.itemId)).toEqual({ outcome: "restricted_rule", shown: "restricted_rule", released: true, pending: true, revised: false, mail: "pending" });
        expect(await shown(tx, fresh.itemId)).toEqual({ outcome: "no_violation", shown: null, released: false, pending: false, revised: false, mail: "pending" });
        // The release's time is now, never the cut-off.
        const [times] = await tx.execute<{ now: boolean }>(sql`select outcome_sent_at = now() as now from intake_items where id = ${cleared.itemId}::uuid`);
        expect(times!.now).toBe(true);
        // A second release with the same cut-off changes nothing.
        expect(await release(tx, "1 hour")).toBe(0);
      });
    });

    test("a changed outcome is shown at the release after its reversal, its mail is due again only when what is shown changes, and a sender without a mail gets none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        // Whatever other suites' decisions left releasable in the shared database goes first, so the counts below are this test's own.
        await release(tx, "1 hour");
        const p = await noticed(tx, 2);
        // A second sender, under a rule: nobody owes them a mail.
        const second = (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId))).recorded.items[0]!.id;
        const [one, two] = p.mediaIds as [string, string];
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, p.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove"), act("remove_media", one), act("remove_media", two)] });
        await decidedAgo(tx, removal, "10 hours");
        expect(await release(tx, "9 hours")).toBe(2);
        expect(await shown(tx, p.itemId)).toMatchObject({ shown: "restricted_rule", pending: false, mail: "pending" });
        expect(await shown(tx, second)).toMatchObject({ shown: "restricted_rule", mail: "none" });
        const sent = () => tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_mail = 'sent' where id = ${p.itemId}::uuid`);
        /** A correction of the removal that lifts these, dated this long ago with the mark it left on the items. */
        const corrected = async (outcome: "partly_reversed" | "reversed", actions: ReturnType<typeof act>[], ago: string) => {
          await decidedAgo(tx, await decideIn(tx, mod, p.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, outcome, actions }), ago);
          await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set revision_pending_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where answered_by = ${removal}::uuid`);

        const [unmoved] = await tx.execute<{ kept: boolean }>(sql`select revised_sent_at = now() - interval '7 hours' as kept from intake_items where id = ${p.itemId}::uuid`);

    test("the cut-off is never in the future; the API role may run the release, and writes neither a release time nor a shown outcome itself", async () => {

        expect(await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_mail = 'sent' where id = ${p.itemId}::uuid`)))).toBeNull();

        expect(await withheld(account.id)).toBe(false);

        await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });

        expect(await withheld(copy.id)).toBe(true);
        expect(await withheld(account.id)).toBe(false);

        const later = await newestSnapshot(tx, (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId))).caseId);
        expect(later.id).not.toBe(copy.id);
        const [held] = await tx.execute<{ body: string | null }>(sql`select body from evidence_snapshots where id = ${later.id}::uuid`);
        expect(held!.body).toBe("");

        expect(await withheld(later.id)).toBe(true);
        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set media = '[{"id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "alt": null, "width": 1, "height": 1}]'::jsonb where id = ${later.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await withheld(later.id)).toBe(false);

        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set erased_at = now(), body = null, media = null, display_name = null, bio = null, salt = null where id = ${account.id}::uuid`);

      });
    });

    test("the API role may ask it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx);
        const copy = await newestSnapshot(tx, (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId))).caseId);
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ withheld: boolean; none: boolean }>(sql`select public.snapshot_withheld(${copy.id}::uuid) as withheld, public.snapshot_withheld(${randomUUID()}::uuid) as none`);
        expect({ ...row! }).toEqual({ withheld: false, none: true });
      }, apiDb);
    });
  });

  describe("case_history", () => {
    test("one row for each item, snapshot, decision and note of the case, with what each event is about and never a text", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx);
        const reporter = await profile(tx);
        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R3"), aPost(p.postId));
        const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
        const notice = (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal")).recorded;
        const snapshot = await newestSnapshot(tx, caseId);
        await saveText(tx, caseId, mod.id, "note", "A note that the history must not carry.");
        const interim = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        const final = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });
        // Another case's events are not this case's.
        await report(tx, aPost((await imagePost(tx)).postId));

        const rows = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
          select event, ref_id, seq, intake_kind, rule_id, alleges_illegal, csam, reexamination, decision_kind, outcome, staff_id, result,
                 date_trunc('milliseconds', at) = date_trunc('milliseconds', now()) as at_now
            from case_history where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        const none = { seq: null, intake_kind: null, rule_id: null, alleges_illegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decision_kind: null, outcome: null, staff_id: null, result: null, at_now: true };
        const [note] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from staff_texts where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and kind = 'note'`);
        const expected = [
          { ...none, event: "item", ref_id: recorded.items[0]!.id, seq: 1, intake_kind: "user", rule_id: "R3", alleges_illegal: false, csam: false, reexamination: false },
          { ...none, event: "item", ref_id: notice.items[0]!.id, seq: 2, intake_kind: "user", alleges_illegal: true, csam: false, reexamination: false },
          { ...none, event: "snapshot", ref_id: snapshot.id },
          { ...none, event: "note", ref_id: note!.id },
          { ...none, event: "decision", ref_id: interim, decision_kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", staff_id: mod.id },
          { ...none, event: "decision", ref_id: final, decision_kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident", staff_id: mod.id },
        ];
        const byRef = (a: Record<string, unknown>, b: Record<string, unknown>) => String(a.ref_id).localeCompare(String(b.ref_id));
        expect(rows.map((row) => ({ ...row })).sort(byRef)).toEqual([...expected].sort(byRef));
        // The view has no column that could carry a text.
        const columns = await tx.execute<{ name: string; type: string }>(sql`select attname::text as name, atttypid::regtype::text as type from pg_attribute where attrelid = 'public.case_history'::regclass and attnum > 0`);
        expect(columns.filter((column) => column.type === "text").map((column) => column.name).sort()).toEqual(["event", "rule_id"]);
      }, apiDb);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
